claims.statement: The summarize stage runs on a single backend still named agno (the only allowed summary.backend): it makes direct OpenRouter chat-completions calls and the engine publishes via the Notion REST API with no MCP and no model tool-calling; the legacy agy backend is removed.

summarize and notion are treated as one manifest-coupled stage pair: the orchestrator skips the summarize backend only when both summarize and notion are already complete, and marks both complete in the same step after a successful backend run.

Slide markdown is embedded in the summary prompt as fenced reference-only context via _slide_block/_fence_for and the model is told not to reproduce it; the summary file stays slide-free while cleaned slides go to a separate <name>.slides-clean.md and the Notion Slide Descriptions child page.

The agno-named backend produces the summary and digest via two direct OpenRouter chat-completions calls reading choices[0].message.content, the engine writes <name>.md + <name>.telegram.md (+ <name>.slides-clean.md) first and then publishes via publish_to_notion; a Notion failure fails the whole summarize+notion stage and the publish-record sidecar is written only after success.

The direct Notion REST publish extracts the parent page id from notion.parent_page_id (bare id or Notion URL), converts the Markdown summary into Notion block objects losing nothing, creates the subpage in ≤100-block chunks, and, when cleaned slide descriptions are non-empty, creates a 'Slide Descriptions' child page under the summary page.

The single summarize backend writes <name>.md as source of truth and <name>.telegram.md as the digest preferred by telegram with full-summary fallback, plus <name>.slides-clean.md when slide content exists (stale files cleared) and the <name>.notion_published.json publish-record sidecar.

Selection is a pure function of summary.backend with no silent fallback: unknown values raise ValueError and config allows only agno; the run is hard time-bound by timeouts.summarize else the default timeout with OpenRouter and Notion work in worker threads, and per-request Notion sockets are capped by min(stage budget, DEFAULT_NOTION_TIMEOUT).

Phase prompts are built by build_agno_summarize_prompt (inlined transcript plus language, sections, slide block from summary.md), build_agno_digest_prompt, and build_agno_route_prompt, all encapsulating untrusted text with _fence_for fences longer than any backtick run instead of XML tags.

Direct OpenRouter calls read choices[0].message.content straight from the response to avoid truncation of reasoning-model output, retry 429/5xx with bounded backoff, raise SummarizeError without secrets, and never log keys, tokens, or content.

Telegram topic routing partitions one summary into per-topic plus __default__ remainder digests via a single model call parsed by _parse_route_json with fence-stripping, missing-bucket fill, extra-key ignore, and non-string coercion, falling back to the single digest on failure or all-empty buckets.
